claims.text: Metacognition provides a coherent framework to understand and design for usability challenges in Generative AI systems.
Generative AI systems impose metacognitive demands on users that require high levels of metacognitive monitoring and control.
Integrating metacognitive support strategies into Generative AI systems addresses user metacognitive demands.
Designing Generative AI systems to target explainability and customizability reduces user metacognitive demand.

evidence.description: Metacognition offers a coherent framework for understanding the usability challenges posed by GenAI, and provides novel research and design directions to advance human-AI interaction.

Drawing on research in psychology and cognitive science, and recent GenAI user studies, we illustrate how GenAI systems impose metacognitive demands on users, requiring a high degree of metacognitive monitoring and control.
We propose these demands could be addressed by integrating metacognitive support strategies into GenAI systems...
...and by designing GenAI systems to reduce their metacognitive demand by targeting explainability and customizability.

methodologies.name: Literature Synthesis and Conceptual Framing
methodologies.description: Conceptual mapping based on research from psychology, cognitive science, and user studies to analyze interaction demands in GenAI systems.

limitations.text: Generative AI systems present usability challenges around prompting, evaluating, relying on outputs, and optimizing workflows.

future_work.text: Integrating metacognitive support strategies into Generative AI system designs.
Designing Generative AI systems that target explainability and customizability to lower metacognitive friction.
